name: The Rim
frame: map metres, x east, y north, origin SW corner; yaw clockwise from north; hx along the pad's local x

sites.name: Rim Chora: the kastro
sites.comp: CIS Gloamport Star Bastion with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 120 x 120 m (a star bastion); the Chora's houses are a hand-made town with no layout yet (not in K6), to be laid out round it
sites.stake: The Yard's crew town on the cliff top; the Skala path runs from it down to the Yard

sites.name: Skaros Rock Keep
sites.comp: CIS Gloamport Gun Keep with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 80 x 80 m on the castle rock (a sea work: may stand at the water's edge)
sites.stake: A castle rock (Altis castle ruin dressing) jutting into the lagoon; its guns cover the Yard's water

sites.name: Narrows East Battery (artillery base)
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Small Artillery Base (1-M3)
sites.stake: Guns close the North Narrows to boats; air softens them

sites.name: Narrows East Battery (tower)
sites.stake: Guns close the North Narrows to boats; air softens them

sites.name: Chora AA Umbrella
sites.comp: CIS Heavy AD Tower with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Flower Tower (1-11)
sites.stake: AA over the Chora and the rim; taking it opens the rim to LAATs

sites.name: Narrows West Battery
sites.stake: The other jaw of the Narrows, on Ash Crescent's north tip (its own garrison; reached by boat to its north beach)
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Skala Path Head
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 2-04 (a pass-profile pad 48 x 78 m; here seated level); on the cliff top where the Skala path starts down (the purpose map's point is on the cliff face)
sites.stake: The top of the switchback path down to the Yard; taking it opens op 8's infantry way down

sites.name: Crest Road Checkpoint
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 60 x 80 m (a little over the Small Checkpoint, A2-05)
sites.stake: The crest road south toward the Prophet Massif; taking it links the Chora to the monastery FOB

sites.name: Oyra Head Radar
sites.stake: Watches the north sea and the Coral Shelf; blowing it hides boats on the Coral Shelf from the Narrows guns

sites.name: Oyra Head Landers
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 80 x 120 m; a beach work
sites.stake: A fortified lander on the north tip; taking it opens the tip's beach to boats

sites.name: North Rim Trench
sites.comp: CIS Metal Trench Line with GPs
sites.size_note: KNOWN: op 1 pads; on the rim between Oyra and the Narrows (the purpose map's point, south-west of the town, is boxed in by the cliff and the town)
sites.stake: Covers the rim between Oyra and the Narrows

sites.name: Chora Power Bank
sites.size_note: REDUCED: the composition's own pad (2-14) is 192 x 166 m and no seat for it holds 4 m within 960 m; a 120 x 100 m pad (as op 4's 4-11; needs a smaller cut of the facility)
sites.stake: Power for the Chora's shields and AA; blowing it drops the kastro's shield

sites.name: Ash North Ridge Post
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 60 x 60 m (as op 3's Zavala outpost)
sites.stake: Watches the north end of Ash Crescent and spots for the Narrows West Battery
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Oyra Head Beach Bunkers
sites.stake: Cover the Coral Shelf landfall on Oyra Head

sites.name: Crew Barracks
sites.comp: CIS Medium Logistics Base with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: between Supply Base Small_1 (82 x 65 m) and the Medium FOB (78 x 149 m)
sites.stake: Barracks for the Yard's shift crews; taking it gives the Yard's shift roster (intel)

sites.name: Chora Lower Terraces
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Small Checkpoint (A2-05)
sites.stake: Terraced lanes below the Chora, held by a picket; the covered way up from Skaros

sites.name: Oyra Head Windmill Flak
sites.comp: CIS Minimal AA Flak Cannon with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 40 x 40 m; the windmills are dressing in a row beside it (not a pad)
sites.stake: Flak among a row of sci-fi windmills (OPTRE windmill dressing) that power the Narrows guns; blowing the windmills slows them

sites.name: North Skerry Sensor
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 30 x 30 m on the stack top; air only
sites.stake: Cues the Narrows guns onto boats coming round Oyra Head; killing it lets boats arrive unseen. Only air can reach it
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

7-F Rim Chora: along the crest road from the Prophet Monastery FOB (op 6), past the Crest Road Checkpoint (7-03) (vehicles)
the covered way up from Skaros through the Chora Lower Terraces (7-13), on foot
7-M1 Skaros Rock Keep: down the road from the Chora past the Skala Path Head (7-02) (vehicles)
by boat on the lagoon to the rock once the Narrows are open
7-M2 Oyra: along the rim road from the Chora (vehicles)
down the north road from Oyra Head, from the landers' beach (7-05)
7-M3 Narrows East Battery: along the rim road from Oyra past the North Rim Trench (7-06) (vehicles)
by boat to the shore below the battery (shores list), then up on foot
7-M4 Chora AA Umbrella: by road from the crest road past the Crew Barracks (7-12) and the Power Bank (7-07)
